description: This file defines an enumeration 'BusinessStepCategory' that represents categories used in business process steps, specifically currently only 'LOAN'. It includes a method to retrieve a category by name and overrides toString().

classes.name: BusinessStepCategory
classes.description: An enum representing categories for business step processes, with a method to look up categories by name.

methods.name: getCategoryName
methods.description: Returns the BusinessStepCategory matching the provided category name, or throws IllegalArgumentException if not found.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the BusinessStepCategory as a string.
